_note: The render function is `async` only when the script awaits at its root scope (upstream `hasTopLevelAwait`, which pushes a scope for every block and function). An `await` inside a bare block or an `if` body is not root-scope, so the render function stays synchronous and TypeScript reports TS1308 on each, as upstream does; we made every render function `async` and reported nothing. Upstream additionally reports the compiler's `experimental_async` error on such files (Svelte 5 without `experimental.async`), which is not ported yet.
